features.label: Active offloading insole
features.text: Patented Active Offloading Insole features removable hexagonal foam plugs that can be selectively taken out to create custom pressure relief zones beneath plantar wounds, an advanced treatment not possible with standard CAM walker insoles.

features.label: Secure inner bootie
features.text: A patented inner bootie softgood securely holds the foot to prevent migration on the insole, ensuring the pressure relief zones stay perfectly aligned with your plantar ulcer locations during daily ambulation.

features.label: Rocker bottom outsole
features.text: A wide, low-profile rocker bottom outsole stabilizes the foot and ankle at precisely 90 degrees, critically reducing shear forces during walking and increasing stability for patients with altered gait patterns.

features.label: Wound dressing compatible
features.text: The spacious rigid frame easily accommodates simultaneous use with bulky wound care materials and dressings while allowing quick removal for daily wound site assessment.

features.label: Pdac approved l4386 l4387
features.text: Verified non-pneumatic walking boot, prefabricated and ready to wear or custom fitted.
